name: Syncthing
description: Synchronisez vos dossiers entre appareils, sans cloud tiers.
compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/syncthing:latest
    container_name: syncthing
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID={{PUID}}
      - PGID={{PGID}}
      - TZ={{TZ}}
    ports:
      - "8384:8384"
      - "22000:22000/tcp"
      - "22000:22000/udp"
      - "21027:21027/udp"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - {{DATA}}:/data
